messages:
Alex Kim: Quick holiday poll — cool if folks keep soft string lights on desks after 5pm this week? also thinking we could do a tiny ‘adopt-an-office-elf’ chain. who’s in? :sparkles: :snowman:
Priya Patel: Yes to lights, please keep cords tucked. Elf chain sounds adorable. can we set a 1-day sign-up so everyone gets a turn? :raised_hands:
Miguel Torres: Lights = yes. Elf = yes if the elf comes with cookies. :cookie:
Zoe Chen: If we do the elf, we should give it a ridiculous name and a mini-challenge each day (e.g., leave a haiku). totally down. :laughing:
Samir Gupta: +1. also propose a tiny mini-gift-share (cap $10) — optional, drop on desk anonymously. no pressure.
Nora (People Ops): Love both ideas. We’ll add a 1-day elf signup sheet and a mini-gift sheet. I can send a calendar event for ‘Holiday Desk Lights & Elf Week’ with guidelines (safety, cords, no open flames).
Alex Kim: Cool — Nora if you post the sheet can you use a quick form? simple fields: name, date, desk area, any allergies for treats. link example: `https://tiny.redwood/hf-elf-signup`
Priya Patel: Also can we have a lights curfew? say 9pm? parents + folks on late calls might appreciate.
Zoe Chen: 9pm sounds perfect.
Miguel Torres: 9pm ok. will donate batteries if needed. :battery:
Samir Gupta: For the mini-gift-share, what about a ‘no-name’ box at reception and we shuffle and drop on desks? keeps it anonymous.
Nora (People Ops): Yep — reception box works. I’ll coordinate logistics and put out a short FAQ in the event. items should be wrapped and labeled with desk number only.
ops-bot: Reminder: Kitchen hours for holiday week — closes at 6pm on 12/24 and 12/31. (posted automatically)
Alex Kim: Love it. If anyone wants to start the elf chain early, I volunteer Tuesday. I’ll name it ‘Captain Tinsel’. :tinsel_sparkles: (obvious pun incoming)
Priya Patel: Captain Tinsel is an excellent name. photo challenge: best elf photo gets bragging rights and a digital badge. :medal:
Zoe Chen: I’ll make a tiny badge image and drop it in the event.
Miguel Torres: Photo contest = chef’s kiss. will bring cookie contributions on my elf day.
Samir Gupta: Count me in for bringing extra string lights and tape. also can we have a quick reminder to keep aisles clear? safety first.
Nora (People Ops): Noted — safety guidelines will be in the event. thanks everyone! will post signups by EOD.
Alex Kim: Thanks all — merry early holiday vibes! feel free to drop a desk selfie when your elf arrives. :camera_with_flash:
